name: sub-meter
description: Your subscription usage at the bottom right of Claude Code: the 5-hour and weekly windows, taking turns, side by side or fixed on one of them.

display.title: What the meter shows
display.description: rotate: one window at a time, switching every few seconds. both: the 5-hour and weekly windows side by side. session: only the 5-hour window. week: only the weekly window.

rotateSeconds.title: Seconds per window
rotateSeconds.description: How long the meter shows each window (5-hour, weekly) before it switches to the other. Only used when display is rotate.

showCost.title: Show the session's cost
showCost.description: Draw what the session has cost so far, in dollars, before the windows. Claude Code's own estimate (the one /cost shows), so it can differ from what a gateway bills. Off a subscription it is shown alone.

hideCycleHint.title: Hide the mode cycle hint
hideCycleHint.description: Drop "(shift+tab to cycle)" after the permission mode, to leave room for the meter.

hideInterruptHint.title: Hide the interrupt hint
hideInterruptHint.description: Drop "esc to interrupt" from the hint line while Claude works, to leave room for the meter.
